title: Lightning distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance for lightning using d = U/E, yielding 1000 m.

title: Energy released
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the energy released using E = qU, yielding 1.5e12 J.

title: Average current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average current using I = q/t, yielding 50000 A.

title: Uniform field assumption
description: Important: Applies the formula for a uniform electric field (E = U/d) to relate potential difference and breakdown field.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (V, V/m, C, s) throughout calculations without conversion errors.

title: Incorrect field formula
description: Pitfall: Misapplies the electric field relationship, e.g., using E = d/U or confusing it with Coulomb's law.

title: Sign or power-of-ten error
description: Pitfall: Makes arithmetic errors in powers of ten or misplaces decimal points in final answers.
